parts.note: a firm is a business or company
a hand is a worker or employee, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: A staff member at a business rules with a heavy fist.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive 's on 'employee's' adds no letter; it just joins the pieces to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Firm, strict discipline is iron control, with a grip that never slackens.

clue.text: Secure strong as "X" can make it

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud or strong
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: Fixing something as firmly as a cross allows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can make it' is a link; the X in quotes looks like a mark but is the Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: To fix or lock something firmly in place is to make it secure.

clue.text: In wet weather half of them stop

indicators.note: In says the second half of the word goes inside the weather word

parts.note: rain is wet weather

indicators.note: half of takes the latter two letters of the four-letter word them

explanation.surface: When it's pouring, half of them stay put.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In wet weather' reads as a scene-setter, but 'In' is the container signal; 'stop' means stay, not halt.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay or be left behind is to stop where one is.

clue.text: Chewed a chip and put on weight!

indicators.note: chewed means mangled, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone munched a crisp and gained a few pounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chewed' rearranges A CHIP AND; the definition refers to the racing practice of loading a strong horse with extra weight.
explanation.definitionFit: In horse racing a superior runner is burdened with extra lead to even the field.

indicators.note: from says the letters come out of the run of words one's toiling

explanation.surface: A dwelling earned by one's hard labour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' marks the letters inside oNE'S Toiling.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird's dwelling is a home, and the word is used for any cosy lair.

explanation.surface: Speed up someone's rise through the ranks.
explanation.definitionFit: To speed things up is to raise the pace, and a move upward in rank at work is likewise a rise.

parts.note: to tie is to join or fasten
a Red is a revolutionary communist

explanation.surface: Signing up with the rebel in a seated line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranged in stacked levels, like theatre seating, things are in rows.

clue.text: Being generous and quiet, stick with one girl

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
a rod is a stick
I is the Roman numeral one
gal is an informal word for girl

explanation.surface: Being open-handed and silent, stay faithful to one girlfriend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Being', 'and' and 'with' are links; 'stick with' looks like a phrase meaning stay loyal.
explanation.definitionFit: Lavish and spending freely, as in the parable of the wasteful son.

parts.note: grass hints at cannabis, but the clue describes greenery grown in a container to brighten a room

explanation.walkthrough: 'Grass' tempts toward slang for cannabis or an informer, but the clue simply means indoor greenery.
explanation.definitionFit: A houseplant in a container is greenery used to decorate a room.

clue.text: Monotony affecting seamen on a big ship

indicators.note: affecting suggests the sailors' letters are acted upon and so altered into a new order

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, a large vessel

explanation.surface: Sailors on a large liner suffer from the dull routine of the voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affecting' looks like 'moving emotionally' but signals the rearrangement; 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Monotony is a dull lack of variety, everything staying identical day after day.

explanation.surface: Explain what caused a fracture.
explanation.definitionFit: A written account of events is one sense; the loud bang of a gun firing, a crack, is the other.

parts.note: a cart is a wagon
unloaded read as O on, that is nothing on, a zero placed on top

explanation.surface: Pulling an empty wagon along.
explanation.walkthrough: 'an' is a link; 'unloaded' means the cart has O (nothing) on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic illustration or animated film is a kind of drawing.

clue.text: Draw forth note quite right too!

parts.note: E is a musical note
licit means lawful, permitted, quite right in law

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims approval while coaxing a response out of a person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'too' is a link that rounds off the exclamation; LICIT means lawful, which the surface disguises as hearty agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw forth a reply or reaction is to evoke or extract it.

explanation.surface: Key matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Relevant and significant evidence is one sense; cloth or physical substance is the other.

parts.note: to sever is to cut
L is a learner, as on a learner driver's L-plate

explanation.surface: Not many people slash a new recruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Few' sits first, reading like an adjective, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: More than two but not many: a handful.

clue.text: Gifts of money no longer made

explanation.surface: Presents of coins that are no longer minted.
explanation.walkthrough: The talent was a weight and unit of currency in the ancient world, as in the Biblical parable.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural aptitudes are gifts; the talent was also an ancient unit of money long out of use.

parts.note: VA is the short form of the US state Virginia
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A small Southern girl is well liked, though she is full of herself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little' marks the abbreviation of Virginia, not a young person.
explanation.definitionFit: A conceited person, puffed up with self-regard, is described this way.

clue.text: A time set for changing the rating

indicators.note: changing indicates the letters of a time set are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A schedule is fixed for revising the score.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' rearranges A TIME SET; 'for' and 'the' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: An approximate valuation or judgement of worth is a rating.

explanation.surface: Receive smaller sums, as the deal says.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as per' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To shrink or diminish is one sense; a binding legal pact is the other.

explanation.surface: Getting into public transit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; 'transport' here means carry away with delight.
explanation.definitionFit: A way in is access; to delight or bewitch is to transport someone.

clue.text: Work like a dog or strike?

explanation.surface: Should one toil hard or down tools?
explanation.definitionFit: To toil laboriously is one sense; to hit hard with a wild swing is the other.

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
bound means obliged, as in duty-bound

explanation.surface: Troops are required to bounce back from hardship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something resilient springs back after impact, recovering its shape.

clue.text: A card game could be pontoon

explanation.surface: One card game might turn out to be another, pontoon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' is a link; pontoon looks like the card game, but a pontoon is a floating crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: A partnership card game for four is one sense; a structure spanning a river, such as a floating pontoon, is the other.

clue.text: Only about a hundred will find relief

indicators.note: about tells us the word for only goes around the other pieces

parts.note: sole means only, single
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Just a hundred people will be comforted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts SOLE around AC; 'will find' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Comfort in grief or distress brings relief.

clue.text: Direct the formation of a certain trust

indicators.note: the formation of signals the letters of direct are built into another word

explanation.surface: Manage the creation of a particular trust fund.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the formation of' rearranges DIRECT.
explanation.definitionFit: Belief in someone's honesty, or a lender's faith in repayment, is a kind of trust.

indicators.note: arranged tells us the letters of in travel are put into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A rest stop has been booked as part of a journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' rearranges the letters of IN TRAVEL.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause between acts or halves of a performance is a break.

indicators.note: outside says the word for love goes round the letter for right

parts.note: amour is French for love, used in English for a love affair
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Affection surrounding what is just is a person's protection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts AMOUR around R.
explanation.definitionFit: Protective metal plating worn by knights or fitted to tanks is a defence.

indicators.note: comeback means the word for senseless is turned back to front

parts.note: nuts means crazy, senseless

explanation.surface: An absurd retort causes a jolt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comeback' turns NUTS around; 'causing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To daze or astonish someone is to shock them.

clue.text: A fellow with an American lawyer, a woman

parts.note: a fellow is a man
DA is a District Attorney, a US public prosecutor

explanation.surface: A man accompanied by a US attorney meets a female.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a female first name, so the woman is anyone so named.

explanation.surface: Flags as a rule.
explanation.definitionFit: A regimental flag is called the colours; a benchmark or norm to follow is a guideline.

explanation.surface: A dining joke about a dish with no exit.
explanation.walkthrough: The French word also means admission or the way in, the opposite of a way out.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means right of admission, the way in rather than out, and also a dish served at a meal.

clue.text: It's natural to see point in neither alternative

indicators.note: in tells us the compass letter sits within the word neither
alternative signals a different arrangement of the letters gathered so far

parts.note: N is north, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: It's normal to find a spot in neither of two options.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts N inside NEITHER, and 'alternative' rearranges the eight letters; 'It's' and 'to see' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Something built in by nature is intrinsic, a quality that belongs to it essentially.
